sentences.text: I have gone through the affidavit filed in support of this application.
The cause shown is sufficient.
The order dated 29.01.2016 is recalled and Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is restored to its original number.
This application is, accordingly, allowed.

Order Date :- 23.9.2019/AK Case :-
APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 2293 of 2001 Applicant :- Brahamanand Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Sharma, Sanjay Agrawal Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
The application is restored to its original number vide order of date passed on recall application.

2. Heard Sri Sanjay Agrawal, learned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. for State.
3.

Applicant has invoked jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 (hereinafter referred to as "Cr.P.C.") with a prayer to quash the proceedings of Case No. 2510 of 1994, under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954") pending in the Court of First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra.

entities.text: First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. It is contended that Public Analyst Report was not supplied to applicant and, therefore, there is no compliance of Section 13(2) of Act, 1954.

5. This issue involves evidence and finding on fact for which matter has to be decided by Trial Court and matter is till pending before Trial Court and this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is coming in the mid way.
I, therefore, do not find any reason to interfere at this stage.
6. Application is accordingly dismissed.
Order Date :- 23.9.2019 AK  Brahamanand vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23 September, 2019
